cohort: The study included 2183 Syrian refugee women delivering in a government hospital in Lebanon under the coverage of the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR).
finding: The C-section rate among Syrian refugees in Lebanon dramatically increased compared to pre-war Syrian rates, and was significantly associated with maternal age, day of the week, gestational age, and male babies.
mod_finding: The C-section rate among Syrian refugees in Lebanon dramatically increased compared to the Syrian population's pre-war rates, doubling the WHO recommended optimal rate.
